podcast.body: In November 1984, Bob Geldof was actively trying to generate publicity for The Boomtown Rats' new album, "In the Long Grass." His efforts were not proving successful, leading to a frustrating day that preceded his inspiration for Band-Aid. "He had been on the phone trying to drum up some publicity for a new Rats album called In the Long Grass, but you really wasn't getting anywhere."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: From the Archives: The Top 100 Moments in New Rock - Part 3
